text: According to the connectivity section, the network topology (Erdos-Renyi vs small-world vs scale-free) is a primary hyperparameter that matters more than ρ and σ_in.
explanation: False: Section 8.6 classifies connectivity/topology as a secondary hyperparameter — structured topologies typically beat Erdos-Renyi by <10% and only task-specifically. The primary knobs ρ and σ_in matter far more and should be tuned first.
